einzeiler: Dr. Cameron Chesnut shares the details of treating acne scarring with lasers and fat…
kurzfassung: Dr. Cameron Chesnut returns to discuss the specifics of a recent combination laser and fat transfer procedure performed on the host. The conversation covers the complexities of facial aging, the realities of recovery, and the scientific backing behind regenerative treatments. They also examine the pros and cons of popular alternatives like fillers and biostimulators.
stichpunkte: Discussion of the host's custom laser cocktail and stem-cell rich fat transfer procedure
Explanation of how fractional and ablative CO2 lasers target skin structure and scars
Comparison of fat transfer with temporary hyaluronic acid fillers and biostimulators
Surgical insights into the behavior of fillers and sculptra under the skin over time
Detailed breakdown of post-procedure recovery protocols including hyperbaric oxygen therapy
The role of microplastics awareness in medical and clinical settings
Managing expectations and understanding the long-term timeline of tissue remodeling

clips.text: The plastic surgeon notes that he declines treatment requests the vast majority of the time during initial consultations.

clips.hook: The reality of hyaluronic acid fillers
clips.text: Hyaluronic acid gel fillers are described as resembling wet floating sugar when removed during surgical procedures.

clips.hook: The surprising science of in utero surgery
clips.text: Fetal surgery performed inside the womb results in babies being born with zero scarring.
Standard operating rooms expose patients to significant amounts of microplastics through IV fluids and medical tubing.

clips.hook: Lengthening DNA caps with hyperbaric chambers
clips.text: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy is noted to cause a direct lengthening of telomeres, which are the protective caps on DNA strands.

beschreibung:
Dr. Cameron Chesnut is back for Part 2, and we're getting into everything. What we actually did to my face, what the recovery has really looked like, and the honest timeline for results.

I came to Dr. Chesnut with acne scarring, hyperpigmentation, and some volume loss. We break down the custom laser cocktail (four lasers total) paired with stem cell-rich fat transfer, why he tailors every treatment differently, and how to shop for a laser provider without getting sold whatever device they happen to own.

We also get real about filler and Sculptra, including what filler actually looks like when Dr. Chesnut removes it surgically and why he takes a more cautious approach to biostimulators. Plus, the full recovery protocol I followed: hyperbaric oxygen, microplastic-free IV nutrition, red light, PEMF, and more.

If you've been curious about CO2 laser, fat transfer, or whether going the long-play route is worth it, this one answers it honestly.
